report_comment.text: CBFB encodes the non-DNA-binding beta subunit of the core-binding factor transcription complex. MYH11 encodes smooth-muscle myosin heavy chain, a contractile motor protein. The inv(16)/t(16;16) rearrangement joins CBFB and MYH11 and is associated with myelomonocytic AML with abnormal eosinophils. Under adult ELN 2022 intensive-treatment criteria, CBFB::MYH11 AML is assigned to the favorable genetic-risk group.
